findings: No video supplied. Motion guidance is inferred from DOM animation hints and the knowledge matrix.

pushbacks: Strengthen the hero H1 so the value proposition is understandable without scrolling.
Add a primary above-the-fold CTA with concrete commercial intent.
requiredBlocks: Hero with niche-specific offer for Taller de motos, a concise proof point, and one primary CTA.
Trust block near the first friction point: testimonials, metrics, client logos, or before/after proof.
Offer explanation section that makes the buying path obvious.
Conversion-focused contact or booking flow with minimal fields.
Accessible footer with business identity, navigation, and legal links.

performanceBudget.jsBudget: Keep route-level JS lean; lazy-load WebGL and heavy animation bundles.
performanceBudget.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and pause offscreen animation.

motionDirectives: Use sticky sections to sequence proof and offer clarity, not to delay the CTA.
Keep transform/opacity as the primary animation properties to avoid layout thrash.
accessibility: Use semantic HTML landmarks and descriptive accessible names.
Maintain WCAG AA contrast for text over glass, video, gradients, and WebGL canvases.
Keyboard states must be visible and match hover affordances.
Provide reduced-motion alternatives for scroll-linked animation.
seo: One clear H1, metadata aligned with the offer, structured headings, and descriptive link text.
Render core content server-side or statically where possible.
Reserve canvas/WebGL for enhancement, not for critical copy.

interactions.magneticCursor: Pointer target interpolation using lerp(current, target, 0.12) with reduced-motion fallback and hit-area constraints.
interactions.lerp: Linear interpolation: next = current + (target - current) * alpha. Use alpha between 0.08 and 0.18 for premium UI easing.
interactions.inverseKinematics: Chain-based motion where parent/child transforms solve toward a target; useful for articulated menus, ribbons, and cursor trails.
interactions.progressivePixelScroll: Scroll progress maps to pixelation, blur, or shader uniforms, ideally throttled through requestAnimationFrame.

visualEffects.backdropFilters: Layer translucent surfaces with backdrop-filter: blur() and contrast(), but keep text contrast measurable.
visualEffects.dynamicClipPaths: Use clip-path polygons or inset() transitions to reveal content without layout reflow.
visualEffects.borderBeams: Conic-gradient border animation masked to the border box; pause offscreen and avoid large repaint regions.
visualEffects.alphaMaskedMarquee: Use mask-image linear gradients on marquee edges so infinite movement fades naturally.
visualEffects.flashlight: Pointer-fed radial-gradient spotlight stored in CSS variables, with keyboard and reduced-motion equivalents.

webgl3d.shaders: Fragment shaders color pixels; vertex shaders deform geometry. Expose uniforms for scroll, time, pointer, and theme.
webgl3d.noise: Perlin/Simplex noise generates organic displacement, liquid surfaces, grain, and hover distortions.
webgl3d.gpuOptimization: Promote only moving layers with will-change, batch reads/writes, and keep animation work in requestAnimationFrame.
